# Bundled third-party files

These are unmodified copies, shipped here so the app runs offline. Each keeps its own license.

| File | Project | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pdf.min.js`, `pdf.worker.min.js` | [pdf.js](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/) | 3.11.174 | Apache 2.0 (`LICENSE-pdfjs.txt`) |
| `pdf-lib.min.js` | [pdf-lib](https://pdf-lib.js.org/) | 1.17.1 | MIT (`LICENSE-pdf-lib.txt`) |
| `tesseract/` (`tesseract.min.js`, `worker.min.js`, `tesseract-core-*.wasm.js`, `lang/eng.traineddata.gz`) | [Tesseract.js](https://tesseract.projectnaptha.com/) 5.1.1 (core 5.1.1, English data 4.0.0_best_int) | Apache 2.0 (`tesseract/LICENSE-*.txt`) |
| `fonts/Caveat.ttf`, `fonts/DancingScript.ttf`, `fonts/GreatVibes.ttf` | Google Fonts (Caveat, Dancing Script, Great Vibes) | as of Oct 2026 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`fonts/OFL-*.txt`) |

The JavaScript files come from cdnjs.cloudflare.com (`/ajax/libs/pdf.js/3.11.174/`, `/ajax/libs/pdf-lib/1.17.1/`); the fonts from fonts.gstatic.com. To update one, replace the file and keep the name.
